title: 第一卷 第1章 开局杀了主角全家第一卷 第2章 大梁女帝
slug: 本书主角已下线请反派大人签收机缘
content_zh:
“侯爷，萧家罪女给您送来了。”
汪海迷迷糊糊地睁开眼。
下意识地想要伸手去揉，手臂却触到了一片温软细腻的肌肤。
他低头一看。
一个女子正躺在他怀中。
双手被绸带缚在身后，浑身不着片缕。
汪海的脑子“嗡”地一声。
萧璃月？
大乾女帝？！
不，不对。
那不是小说里的人物吗？
汪海浑浑噩噩的脑袋忽然惊醒。
无数尘封的记忆如潮水般涌来。
他记起来了。
全都记起来了。
他是个穿越者！
他自小就聪慧异常，能言善辩，却总感觉似乎有什么东西忘记了。
三岁那年，他想起了一首《咏鹅》，震惊京城。
可从那以后，便再也想不起任何事情，泯然众人。
原来他是穿越者。

可惜，如今觉醒了前世宿慧，他却一点也高兴不起来。
他刚刚把萧家给抄了！
萧家一百三十七口人，一夜之间血流成河，只剩下眼前这个萧璃月，被他带回了府中，准备享用。
这原本也不是什么大事。
至少在他觉醒宿慧之前，不是什么大事。
他乃大梁忠义侯，女帝帝空明的心腹宠臣。
不要说把萧家给抄了。
就算是把萧家全族给操了，那也不过就是一个风流韵事。
谁敢说他半个不字？
可惜，这是个小说世界！
主角萧凡，姓萧！
正是刚刚被他抄没全族的萧家。
要死！要死！要死！
汪海额头沁出冷汗，手指不自觉地收紧，掐得怀中的萧璃月闷哼一声。
汪海看了一眼萧璃月。
放了？
没有用！
content_en:
"Master Marquis, the criminal daughter of the Xiao family has been sent to you."
Wang Hai opened his eyes drowsily.
Subconsciously, he wanted to reach out and rub it, but his arm touched a piece of warm, soft and delicate skin.
He looked down.
A woman was lying in his arms.
His hands were tied behind his back by silk ribbons, and he was completely naked.
Wang Hai's mind buzzed.
Xiao Liyue?
Daqian Empress? !
No, that's not right.
Isn't that a character in a novel?
Wang Hai's confused head suddenly woke up.
Countless dusty memories came flooding back.
He remembered.
Remembered it all.
He is a time traveler!
He has been extremely intelligent and eloquent since he was a child, but he always feels that he has forgotten something.
When he was three years old, he remembered the song "Ode to the Goose", which shocked the capital.
But from then on, he could no longer remember anything and was lost in everyone.
It turns out that he is a time traveler.
Unfortunately, now that he has awakened the wisdom of his previous life, he is not happy at all.
He just ransacked the Xiao family!
One hundred and thirty-seven members of the Xiao family were bleeding like rivers overnight, and only Xiao Liyue was left in front of him, who was brought back to his house to enjoy.
This was not a big deal originally.
At least it wasn't a big deal until he awakened to Su Hui.
He is the Zhongyihou of Daliang and a confidant of the empress Di Kongming.
Don't say that the Xiao family was copied.
Even if the entire Xiao family is fucked, it is just a romantic affair.
Who dares to say that he is half-literate?
Unfortunately, this is a novel world!
The protagonist Xiao Fan, surnamed Xiao!
It was the Xiao family whose entire family had just been confiscated by him.
To die! To die! To die!
Cold sweat broke out on Wang Hai's forehead, and his fingers tightened unconsciously, causing Xiao Liyue in his arms to groan.
Wang Hai glanced at Xiao Liyue.
Let go?
It's no use!
